Industrial local supervisoryMitsubishi Q/R Series Dual-PLC
V2.2.1
ESP32 local gateway

Open your PLC dashboard

This public page is a launcher. The actual monitoring and control interface runs locally on the ESP32 gateway connected to your RUBY network. Enter the gateway address shown on its LCD or Arduino Serial Monitor.

Use the current ESP32 IP address. Example only: http://192.168.3.238

01 · POWERTurn on RUBY, both PLCs and the ESP32 gateway.
02 · CONNECTConnect your phone or laptop to the RUBY Wi-Fi network.
03 · OPENEnter the ESP32 IP and open its local dashboard.
Important: The hosted page cannot operate the PLCs directly. It navigates to the ESP32-hosted dashboard so normal monitoring and any commissioned control run on the same local origin. Do not expose the ESP32 using public port forwarding.
Primary offline entry: http://<ESP32-IP>/ · If this public page cannot load without internet, open the local address directly.
Physical PLC writes remain disabled by default until local commissioning approval.
